init.title: Eufy Robomow options
init.description: Observe-only disables mower and settings writes. The local backend polls the mower itself. The bridge backend reads state from the dedicated mower bridge and routes start, pause, resume and dock through it while the bridge runs in control mode. Dock uses the bridge's stop route, which returns the owned E15 to the dock. Settings have no bridge route. The map is always read-only. The external map source reads the map source URL, leave it empty to disable the map entity. The bridge map source reads the mower bridge's map route and needs the bridge backend.

data_description.operating_mode: observe_only is the safe default; control enables physical mower commands and setting changes.
data_description.backend: local keeps this integration's own polling and cloud client. bridge reads state from the mower bridge, routes start, pause, resume and dock through it and creates no local connection.
data_description.bridge_url: http or https base URL of the mower bridge, for example http://127.0.0.1:8090.
data_description.bridge_token: The bridge's bearer token. It is stored in this entry's options.
data_description.bridge_mower_id: The mower id from the bridge's discovery. Leave empty when the bridge discovers exactly one mower.
data_description.bridge_certificate_fingerprint: Optional pin for a private or self-signed TLS certificate on an https bridge URL.
data_description.map_source: external reads the map source URL below, the existing source and the manual recovery path. bridge reads the map route of the mower bridge above and keeps the URL for recovery.
data_description.map_source_url: Base URL of a compatible E15 map source.
data_description.map_certificate_fingerprint: Optional pin for a private or self-signed TLS certificate.
